violation_type.typical_finding: Of the four personnel records evaluated, one file lacked documentation of current First Aid and CPR training,

finding_variants.text: Of the four personnel records evaluated, one file lacked documentation of current First Aid and CPR training,
Documentation of current First Aid and CPR training for one staff was not available for review.

One out of two staff files did not contain a current CPR/First-aid certification. The employee start date is documented as 08/25/2023. The second staff file observed CPR/first-aid certification expired 04/16/2023.
